weather: Winter conditions on the high passes: Fergana Gateway (Ala-Bel pass) chains required, Kök-Bel road chains required.

routes.name: Otmek tunnel
routes.label: Open
routes.note: Open all year. Dangerous goods only from 22:00 to 05:00. The old pass road above the tunnel: closed for the season.

routes.name: Fergana Gateway (Ala-Bel pass)
routes.label: Chains required
routes.note: Low −12°C. After snowfall, traffic may go over in convoys behind the ploughs from the summit maintenance station.

routes.name: Kök-Bel road
routes.label: Chains required
routes.note: Low −9°C. Most drivers take the lowland road by Kyzyl-Adyr (335 km) instead.

routes.name: Qara-Chik crossing
routes.road: Kara-Buura valley, 15 km south of Kyzyl-Adyr
routes.label: Open
routes.note: Open to travellers with an ISEZ exit registration and an invitation from the clan council. The pass road beyond it to the Chatkal valley: chains required.
